item.title: More Creepers Add-On
item.creator: Heropixel Games
item.description:
BOOOM! Add more unique Creepers to your world.

+ 30 ultimate Creeper
+ Amazing explosions
+ Charged by lightning
+ Collect their heads
+ Customizable settings
+ Vibrant Visuals support
item.changelog:
+ Fully Customizable settings
+ Control Creeper spawn rates
+ Toggle Creepers on/off
+ Vibrant Visuals Support 
+ Charged Lightning Creepers 
+ 20 more new Creepers
+ Texture Variants 
+ More different explosions 
+ More Creeper heads

faqEntries.heading: Can I control which Creepers appear?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Use the customizable settings to toggle Creepers ON or OFF.

faqEntries.heading: Can I change how often Creepers spawn?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Creeper spawn rates can be customized.

faqEntries.heading: How many Creepers are included?
faqEntries.content: More Creepers adds 35 unique Creepers to discover.

faqEntries.heading: What is the Creeper Guide Tablet?
faqEntries.content: It contains useful information about the Creepers included in the Add-On.

faqEntries.heading: Can Creepers become charged?
faqEntries.content: Yes! All Creepers can be charged by lightning.

faqEntries.heading: Does the Add-On support Vibrant Visuals?
faqEntries.content: Yes! More Creepers supports Vibrant Visuals, with some Creeper parts glowing beautifully at night.

howToEntries.heading: CREEPER GUIDE TABLET
howToEntries.content: Use the Creeper Guide Tablet to learn about the different Creepers included in the Add-On.

howToEntries.heading: CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORLD
howToEntries.content:
Open the Add-On settings to:
- Toggle Creepers ON/OFF
- Change Creeper spawn rates
- Customize your experience

howToEntries.heading: DISCOVER NEW CREEPERS
howToEntries.content: Explore your world and discover 30 unique Creepers with different looks, abilities and explosions!

howToEntries.heading: COLLECT CREEPER HEADS
howToEntries.content: Defeat Creepers to collect their unique heads. You can build with them!

howToEntries.heading: CHARGED CREEPERS
howToEntries.content: The Creepers can become even more powerful when struck by lightning. Be careful [!]

howToEntries.heading: VIBRANT VISUALS
howToEntries.content:
Vibrant Visuals is supported for a stunning visual experience!
Have fun exploring and watch out...
BOOOM!
